workflow:
Evaluate condition: 7: Pipeline
B082 cbc:Mode Code M 1 n1 Specify Inward Transport Mode.
Evaluate condition: B076 cbc:Conveyance Reference Number C 1 an..17 For transport mode = 1, specify inward voyage number.

Evaluate condition: Specify ‘NA’
if there is no inward voyage number.
B078 cbc:Net Register Tonnage C 1 n..15 Specify the Net Register Ton of outward vessel (TNE).

cbc:Net Register Tonnage
C
1 n..15

cac:Outward Carrier Agent Party

Run validation: a) For all Declaration Types except GTR, BKT, SFZ (with inter-
gateway movement), REX, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Importer)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
AM
b) For Declaration Type = GTR, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Claimant)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Importer)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
c) For Declaration Type = BKT, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Claimant; required for duty exemption and/or GST relief)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional)
- (Importer)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
d) For Declaration Type = SFZ (with inter-gateway movement), specify
Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Declaring Agent; if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Outward Carrier Agent; optional if goods are meant for storage
in FTZ or transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or 7)
- (Importer)
- (Consignee; optional)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
e) For Declaration Types REX, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Outward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Importer)
- (Exporter)
- (Consignee; optional)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
A014 cac:Declarant Party M 1 Specify the identity of the Declarant.

Run validation: TDS41-MDS-XML-INPDEC-M
Trade Net Declaration.INPDEC Ver2.1.doc
OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
b) For Declaration Type = GTR, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Claimant)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Importer)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
c) For Declaration Type = BKT, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Claimant; required for duty exemption and/or GST relief)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional)
- (Importer)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
d) For Declaration Type = SFZ (with inter-gateway movement), specify
Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Declaring Agent; if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Outward Carrier Agent; optional if goods are meant for storage
in FTZ or transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or 7)
- (Importer)
- (Consignee; optional)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
e) For Declaration Types REX, specify Party Type:
- (Declarant)
- (Declaring Agent, if declared by Agent)
- (Inward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode = 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Outward Carrier Agent; optional for transport mode 2, 3, 5 or
7)
- (Importer)
- (Exporter)
- (Consignee; optional)
- (Freight Forwarder; optional)
A014
cac:Declarant Party
M
1
Specify the identity of the Declarant.

Run validation: /cac:Party Name
/cac:Freight Forwarder Party
A040 cac:Inward Carrier Agent Party C 1 a) Specify Inward Carrier Agent, must be registered with Customs.

Handle exception: a) For all Declaration Types, specify inward transport, except
for the following:
i) goods released from licensed premises such as Licensed
Warehouse, Excise Factory, Zero-GST Warehouse, Bonded
Warehouse
ii) declaration type = BKT (Blanket)
iii) declaration type = SHO
iv) for goods previously exempted/suspended from duties/taxes
v) supplementary declaration for schemes under AISS, IGDS
such as place of receipt = AISSLOC, SPIGDS
b) For Declaration Type = SFZ (when there is intergateway
movement):
i) Specify Inward transport.
